3977:38650.name: Focus indicators are implemented in code (CSS :focus-visible), not as a Figma component state or variant. No interactive component in this file has a built-in focus variant — this is intentional, not a gap. The Focus ring / Standard and Focus ring / Increased contrast components below document the intended visual treatment for developers to reference, satisfying WCAG 2.4.11 (Focus Appearance).

variables.name: text/primary
variables.description: Main body text — AAA contrast

variables.description: Supporting/muted text — AA contrast

variables.name: text/disabled
variables.description: Disabled state text

variables.name: border/low
variables.description: Default border. Opacity-based: adapts to any surface. Light: Black/Alpha/15, Dark: White/Alpha/15.

variables.name: border/strong
variables.description: Emphasized border

variables.name: status/error/text
variables.description: Error state text — AA on bg

variables.description: Error state icon

variables.description: Error state border

variables.name: icon/default
variables.description: Default icon colour

variables.name: icon/brand
variables.description: Brand-coloured icon

variables.name: icon/disabled
variables.description: Disabled icon colour — 30% opacity, same weight as text/disabled. Use on all non-interactive icon states.

variables.name: Primary/Disabled
variables.description: Faded, low-opacity version of Core. Use only on disabled primary buttons, links, or controls — never as a standalone background.

variables.name: Primary/Light
variables.description: Mid-tone step between Subtle and Core. Reserved for future use — not yet consumed by any component. If you need a lighter alternative to Core that still reads as clearly brand-coloured, this is the step to reach for.

variables.name: Primary/Core
variables.description: The primary brand colour. Use for primary buttons, key actions, and the single most prominent brand-coloured element on a screen.

variables.name: Black/Alpha/10
variables.description: Black at 10% opacity — subtle tint layer.

variables.name: White/Alpha/10
variables.description: White at 10% opacity — subtle light layer.

variables.name: Transparent/Full
variables.description: Fully transparent — rgba(0,0,0,0). Use for invisible fills where a bound variable is required.

variables.name: border/medium
variables.description: Medium border, slightly stronger. Opacity-based. Light: Black/Alpha/20, Dark: White/Alpha/25.

variables.name: button/primary/surface
variables.description: Primary button fill surface. Tracks action/primary across interactive states.

variables.name: button/primary/label
variables.description: Primary button label colour. White (action/primary/label) by default, translucent white when disabled.

variables.name: button/primary/icon
variables.description: Primary button icon colour. Matches button/primary/label.

variables.name: button/secondary/outline
variables.description: Secondary button border/outline colour.

variables.name: button/secondary/surface
variables.description: Secondary button surface fill. Transparent at rest, brand-tinted on hover/pressed.

variables.name: button/secondary/label
variables.description: Secondary button label text colour.

variables.name: button/secondary/icon
variables.description: Secondary button icon colour. Matches button/secondary/label.

variables.name: button/text/label
variables.description: Ghost/text button label colour.

variables.name: button/text/icon
variables.description: Ghost/text button icon colour. Matches button/text/label.

variables.name: icon-btn/surface
variables.description: Icon button background. Transparent at rest, surface fills on hover/pressed.

variables.name: icon-btn/icon
variables.description: Icon button icon colour.

variables.name: spinner/track
variables.description: Spinner background track ring.

variables.name: spinner/indicator
variables.description: Spinner animated fill arc (brand-coloured).

variables.name: Black/Alpha/15
variables.description: Black at 15% opacity. Use for border/default opacity equivalent on light surfaces.

variables.name: White/Alpha/15
variables.description: White at 15% opacity. Use for border/default opacity equivalent on dark surfaces.

variables.name: White/Alpha/30
variables.description: White at 25% opacity. Use for border/medium opacity equivalent on dark surfaces.

variables.name: Primary/Label
variables.description: Label colour on Primary/Core surfaces — the text and icon colour to use on top of a primary brand-coloured fill. Auto-inverts for light primaries (e.g. Verdant, Gold) to ensure AA contrast in both light and dark modes.

variables.name: button/primary/overlay
variables.description: Interaction overlay — layered on top of component fill. Transparent in Default/Error/Disabled, Black/15% on Hover/Focus, Black/25% on Pressed.

variables.name: Secondary/Core
variables.description: The secondary brand colour. Use for secondary buttons, links, and accents that need brand presence without competing with the primary action colour.

variables.name: button/secondary/overlay
variables.description: Overlay applied on top of Brand/Core for the secondary button. 80% black for Default/Pressed/Focus. Transparent for Hover — revealing the brand color.

variables.name: button/primary/overlay/default
variables.description: Transparent overlay on primary button at rest. No tint — base colour shows through.

variables.name: button/primary/overlay/hover
variables.description: Semi-transparent light overlay on primary button hover. Lightens the brand fill slightly.

variables.name: button/primary/overlay/pressed
variables.description: Stronger overlay on primary button press. More pronounced lightening than hover.

variables.name: button/primary/overlay/disabled
variables.description: Overlay for disabled primary button. Combined with surface opacity to signal non-interactive state.

variables.name: button/secondary/overlay/default
variables.description: Transparent overlay on secondary button at rest.

variables.name: button/secondary/overlay/hover
variables.description: Semi-transparent overlay on secondary button hover.

variables.name: button/secondary/overlay/pressed
variables.description: Stronger overlay on secondary button press.

variables.name: button/secondary/overlay/disabled
variables.description: Overlay for disabled secondary button.

variables.name: action/success/surface
variables.description: Success/confirm button fill. Green/500 — passes AA vs white label.

variables.name: action/success/label
variables.description: Success/confirm button label. Always white.

variables.name: action/destructive/surface
variables.description: Destructive button fill. Red/600 — passes AA vs white label.

variables.name: action/destructive/label
variables.description: Destructive button label. Always white.

variables.name: action/success/icon
variables.description: Success/confirm button label. Always white.

variables.name: action/destructive/icon
variables.description: Destructive button label. Always white.

variables.name: button/text/overlay
variables.description: Overlay applied on top of Brand/Core for the secondary button. 80% black for Default/Pressed/Focus. Transparent for Hover — revealing the brand color.

variables.name: button/text/overlay/default
variables.description: Transparent overlay on text/ghost button at rest.

variables.name: button/text/overlay/hover
variables.description: Semi-transparent overlay on text/ghost button hover. Provides subtle background tint.

variables.name: button/text/overlay/pressed
variables.description: Stronger overlay on text/ghost button press.

variables.name: button/text/overlay/disabled
variables.description: Overlay for disabled text/ghost button.

variables.name: button/link/label
variables.description: Ghost/text button label colour.

variables.name: border/low-accessible
variables.description: Opacity-based border for use on any surface. Light: Black/Alpha/10, Dark: White/Alpha/10.

variables.name: action/success/surface-disabled
variables.description: Success/confirm button fill, disabled state. Green/500 at 30% alpha — same recipe as Primary/Disabled.

variables.name: action/destructive/surface-disabled
variables.description: Destructive button fill, disabled state. Red/600 at 30% alpha — same recipe as Primary/Disabled.

variables.name: Blue/300/Disabled-Alpha/30
variables.description: Blue/300 at 30% opacity — reserved for disabled-state tokens only.

variables.name: Blue/500/Disabled-Alpha/30
variables.description: Blue/500 at 30% opacity — reserved for disabled-state tokens only.

variables.name: Red/500/Disabled-Alpha/30
variables.description: Red/500 at 30% opacity — reserved for disabled-state tokens only.

variables.name: action/secondary/outline
variables.description: Secondary-emphasis action colour, split per property to match action/success and action/destructive convention. Light = Primary brand colour. Dark = Gray/50 (same neutral convention as text/primary), NOT Secondary brand colour.

variables.name: action/secondary/label
variables.description: Secondary-emphasis action colour, split per property to match action/success and action/destructive convention. Light = Primary brand colour. Dark = Gray/50 (same neutral convention as text/primary), NOT Secondary brand colour.

variables.name: action/secondary/icon
variables.description: Secondary-emphasis action colour, split per property to match action/success and action/destructive convention. Light = Primary brand colour. Dark = Gray/50 (same neutral convention as text/primary), NOT Secondary brand colour.

variables.name: action/secondary/outline-disabled
variables.description: Disabled state for action/secondary/outline. Light = Primary brand colour at 30% alpha. Dark = White/Alpha/30, same neutral-disabled convention as text/disabled.

variables.name: action/secondary/label-disabled
variables.description: Disabled state for action/secondary/label. Light = Primary brand colour at 30% alpha. Dark = White/Alpha/30, same neutral-disabled convention as text/disabled.

variables.name: action/secondary/icon-disabled
variables.description: Disabled state for action/secondary/icon. Light = Primary brand colour at 30% alpha. Dark = White/Alpha/30, same neutral-disabled convention as text/disabled.

variables.name: action/success/label-disabled
variables.description: Disabled state for action/success/label. White/Alpha/30 in both modes — label is already neutral (Gray/0) and mode-independent for success, so disabled dimming stays mode-independent too.

variables.name: action/success/icon-disabled
variables.description: Disabled state for action/success/icon. White/Alpha/30 in both modes — icon is already neutral (Gray/0) and mode-independent for success, so disabled dimming stays mode-independent too.

variables.name: action/destructive/label-disabled
variables.description: Disabled state for action/destructive/label. White/Alpha/30 in both modes — label is already neutral (Gray/0) and mode-independent for destructive, so disabled dimming stays mode-independent too.

variables.name: action/destructive/icon-disabled
variables.description: Disabled state for action/destructive/icon. White/Alpha/30 in both modes — icon is already neutral (Gray/0) and mode-independent for destructive, so disabled dimming stays mode-independent too.

variables.name: focus/ring
variables.description: Focus ring stroke colour. Applied as a stroke on the outermost focus indicator ring. Meets WCAG 3:1 contrast against both surface/primary and surface/inverse.

variables.name: Blue/500/Alpha/20
variables.description: Blue/500 at 20% opacity. Used for Secondary button Hover overlay tint in Light mode.

variables.name: Blue/500/Alpha/10
variables.description: Blue/500 at 10% opacity. Used for Secondary button Hover overlay tint in Light mode.

variables.name: action/primary/surface
variables.description: Brand-coloured filled surface. Use for primary buttons, selected states, active indicators, avatar initials backgrounds. Resolves to the primary brand colour.

variables.name: action/primary/on-surface
variables.description: Content colour on action/primary/surface — text and icon colour for anything on a brand-coloured fill. Auto-inverts for light primaries.

variables.name: track/default
variables.description: Off-state track fill for toggle controls. Neutral/150 (#d8d8d8) light, Charcoal/500 dark.

variables.name: action/primary/surface-disabled
variables.description: Disabled brand-coloured filled surface. Aliases Primary/Disabled (Blue/300 at 30% alpha). Use for disabled primary button surface, disabled checked checkbox fill.

variables.name: action/primary/label-disabled
variables.description: Disabled label/text colour on brand-coloured surfaces. White/Alpha/60 light, White/Alpha/30 dark.

variables.name: action/primary/icon-disabled
variables.description: Disabled icon colour on brand-coloured surfaces. White/Alpha/60 light, White/Alpha/30 dark.

variables.name: spinner/indicator
variables.description: Active spinning arc/dots color

variables.name: spinner/track
variables.description: Background track circle/ring color
